title: Ring pooling, actually trained: the place description keeps WHERE in the frame things are (centre / middle ring / edge) instead of one average over the whole frame (re-run of experiment 17, which crashed before training)
hypothesis: Experiment 17's hypothesis was never tested. Its run died 30 s into training on a NameError in a log line (train.py used N_RINGS and RING_EDGES from model.model without importing them), so the scorer recorded 1e9 and the harness marked it REVERTED; that verdict says nothing about ring pooling. The reasoning stands unchanged on the current champion (exp 16: truedop_2024 mission 0.155, usable 86.75%, false fix 2.25%, abstain 11%; all three training photographs 100% usable / 0% false fix at the same held-out viewpoints, so the remaining loss is purely the survey gap). Every member's place feature is a global average (GAP) of its 14x14 and 7x7 trunk maps: an orderless bag that records WHICH roofs, canopy, road surface and shadows are in the 128 m frame but not WHERE. The bag's contents are what a new survey changes (season, sun angle, cars, construction); the spatial arrangement of blocks and streets around the point under the aircraft is what it preserves, and GAP throws that away. Concentric-ring pooling (separate means over the centre disc, middle annulus and outer ring) is just as invariant to heading about the frame centre as GAP, but keeps radial layout. Expectation: part of the 11% abstentions, which on this design are frames where a member or the 3x3 block splits belief between look-alike places with similar bags of texture, become confident correct fixes. Named risk, stated before the run: ring pooling is less tolerant of translation than GAP. The training lattice is 24 m and eval views stand 11-17 m off it, comparable to the 21 px radius of the centre disc, so the centre ring's content shifts substantially between the nearest training vantage and the eval view. If ring pooling fails, the train_capture_diagnostics separate the two explanations: if the training photographs also lose usable fixes at held-out viewpoints, the cause is viewpoint (translation) sensitivity; if they stay at ~100% while 2024 falls, radial layout is itself survey-specific at this resolution. Builds on the exp 12-16 lineage unchanged and reuses experiment 17's implementation verbatim plus the one missing import; no earlier-era experiment changed the pooling of a pretrained trunk.
method: Copy experiment 17's model/model.py and model/train.py from runs/20261101_204833_experiment17/model_src/ (they are the exp 16 champion plus ring pooling) and add the missing import of N_RINGS and RING_EDGES to train.py's `from model.model import (...)`. Mechanism, unchanged from exp 17: in Member.embed the two `.mean(dim=(2,3))` GAP reductions are replaced by fixed, parameter-free concentric-ring pooling (3 rings at normalised radius thresholds 1/3 and 2/3, masks as registered buffers, one matmul per level). The place feature goes from 112-d to 336-d (56 lift channels x 3 rings x 2 levels); embed BatchNorm, cosine prototypes and offset head grow with EMBED_DIM. Nothing else changes.
expected_outcome: mission_score 0.155 -> ~0.10-0.13 on truedop_2024: usable_fix_rate 0.8675 -> ~0.89-0.91, mostly from abstentions (11% -> ~7-9%); false_fix_rate stays <= 0.025 (confidence gate unchanged); median error roughly flat (~32-35 m; the cell head sets resolution). train_capture_diagnostics stay ~0.000-0.01. Refuted if mission >= 0.155. Read the failure mode from the diagnostics as described in the hypothesis: training-photograph usable falling below ~98% means translation sensitivity (the next move would be continuous-vantage jitter in training, or softer/overlapping rings), training photographs at ~100% with 2024 down means radial layout is survey-specific and the orderless average was the more robust summary. Exported fp32 ONNX ~17.4 MB -> ~20-23 MB (gate 32 MiB); host latency ~22 ms, essentially unchanged; training wall time about exp 16's.
init_strategy: pretrained:mobilenet_v2 IMAGENET1K_V1 features[0..17] (torchvision, BSD-3), unchanged from experiment 16
eli5: Until now each navigator described a photo by tipping all its little observations into one bag: 'there are flat roofs, some trees, a wide road', without saying where in the picture they were. A new survey changes many of those observations (leaves, shadows, parked cars) but not the layout of the city. Now the navigator keeps three bags: what is right underneath, what is in a ring around that, and what is at the edge. That still works whichever way the drone faces, and it describes the arrangement of the place. Experiment 17 tried exactly this but crashed on a typo before it trained, so this is the first real test.

stages.name: Camera frame
stages.detail: 128×128 px daytime crop, Berlin only; trained on three survey photographs, scored on a fourth it never saw

stages.name: Feature extractor
stages.detail: NEW: how the description is summarised. As before, the 128 px frame is enlarged to 224 px and read by two independent copies of MobileNetV2 (pre-trained on ImageNet, open BSD-3 licence, fine-tuned on Berlin at a tenth of the usual learning rate), at two depths: a 96-channel 14×14 map and a 320-channel 7×7 map, each lifted to 56 numbers per spot. Instead of averaging each map over the whole frame, it is now averaged separately over three concentric rings: the centre (what is right under the drone), a middle ring, and the outer edge. That still does not depend on which way the drone faces but keeps the layout. 56 numbers × 3 rings × 2 depths = a 336-number description of the place (was 112)

stages.name: Map-cell classifier
stages.detail: each extractor's description is centred, scaled to unit length and compared by angle against one unit-length reference direction per map tile (~3,000 tiles, 128 m each), a compass rather than a lookup table; the angle match times a fixed sharpness (30) is the tile score. The two members' tile-belief maps are averaged to pick the tile. (Reference directions are now 336 numbers long to match the description)

stages.name: Local belief pooling
stages.detail: gathers the averaged belief spread over the winning tile AND its 8 neighbours, and places the fix at the balance point of that local cluster instead of snapping to one tile's centre

stages.name: Within-cell offset
stages.detail: small head per member that nudges the fix from the pooled balance point to the exact spot; the two nudges are averaged

stages.name: Confidence gate
stages.detail: confidence = the SMALLER of the two members' belief on the winning tile plus its 8 neighbours; both navigators must independently back the same place, and if either one spreads its belief elsewhere the drone abstains

stages.name: Training signal
stages.detail: unchanged from experiment 16: cross-survey style mixing inside the feature extractor after MobileNetV2's 3rd, 6th and 10th blocks (training only), angular-margin tile loss, offset loss, paired three-survey batches, re-photographing augmentation, pre-trained blocks at a tenth of the learning rate; targets, epochs and views per epoch unchanged. Training views are enlarged to 224 px exactly as in flight

implementation_brief:
This is a re-run of experiment 17 with its crash fixed. Do NOT re-derive anything.

1. Copy runs/20261101_204833_experiment17/model_src/model.py over model/model.py and runs/20261101_204833_experiment17/model_src/train.py over model/train.py (copy only those two .py files; leave model/pretrained/ and everything else in model/ untouched, in particular model/pretrained/mnv2_features17.pt). Diff each against the current model/ first: the only differences must be the ring-pooling changes (constants LIFT_DIM=56, N_RINGS=3, RING_EDGES=(1/3,2/3), EMBED_DIM=2*LIFT_DIM*N_RINGS=336, MID_HW/DEEP_HW, ring_masks(), the two register_buffer ring masks in Member.__init__, Member._ring_pool, the two GAP .mean(dim=(2,3)) calls in Member.embed replaced by _ring_pool, docstring/log/info-string edits). If anything else differs, keep the current champion's version of it.

2. THE BUG: in model/train.py, the `from model.model import (...)` block (around line 114) does not import N_RINGS or RING_EDGES, but they are used at ~line 436 (startup print), ~line 529 and ~lines 531-532 (info dict). Add N_RINGS and RING_EDGES to that import. Then grep model/train.py for EVERY other uppercase name it uses and confirm each is either defined in train.py or imported (MID_HW and DEEP_HW are defined locally in train.py at ~lines 121-122 as INPUT_PX//16 and INPUT_PX//32; keep them consistent with model.py's).

3. VERIFY BEFORE EXITING (this is the step experiment 17 skipped): run `.venv/bin/python -m pyflakes model/train.py model/model.py` if pyflakes is installed and fix any undefined name (if it is absent, the smoke test below is the check). Then run a smoke test on the local machine: build the model with build_model for the berlin meta, run one forward pass on a random [2,3,128,128] float batch in train mode and in eval mode, assert the embedding is 336-d, and run export_onnx to a temp directory and load the result with onnxruntime on one random frame, checking output shapes match the export contract. Also exercise the train_area startup path far enough that the line-436 print and the info dict construction execute (e.g. a timing run with max_chunks=1 / one tiny epoch if train.py supports it, or by calling the code that builds those strings directly). Never open the eval capture truedop_2024 in any of this; use buckets(meta, "train") only.

4. Contracts to preserve (unchanged from exp 16): train.py's CLI (`python -m model.train --area <area> [--epochs N] [--max-crops-per-bucket N] [--seed N]` and its output directory layout, including the exported ONNX file name the frozen scorer reads) and the ONNX export contract in model/model.py's docstring: input = uint8/float frame as the docstring specifies, outputs (lat, lon, confidence) in the documented form, ImageNet normalisation and the 128->224 resize in-graph, ring masks baked as constants. Training reads only buckets(meta, "train"); nothing under model/ may open truedop_2024. Keep the CUDA-only bf16 autocast, the committee of 2, the cosine head (s=30, m=0.25), MixStyle after features[3],[6],[10], the 3x3 block decode, the min-member confidence gate, losses, augmentation, EPOCHS and schedule exactly as in exp 16. Exported fp32 ONNX must stay <= 32 MiB (expected ~20-23 MB).
